 Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei says Iran rejects US proposal to transfer its stockpile of 60 percent enriched uranium to a third country and that Russia, which offered to receive and store the uranium, has been informed of Tehran’s decision.
 Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has accused the US of conducting “diplomacy through threats” by using and invoking new military capabilities.
